bio.text: Virginia Foxx represents North Carolina's 5th District in the U.S. House and serves as Chairwoman of the House Committee on Rules; she previously chaired the Committee on Education and the Workforce.

Before Congress she spent 10 years in the North Carolina Senate, after her election in 1994, and earlier served as president of Mayland Community College and held administrative posts at Appalachian State University.
She holds an A.B. in English and an M.A.C.T. in sociology from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and an Ed.D. from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro.
She is married to Tom Foxx, and the couple owned a nursery business in Watauga County before she entered Congress.
